newsitem.title: UK: Dry cargo freight steady, poised for further gains.
newsitem.headline: Dry cargo freight steady, poised for further gains.

text.p: Most brokers agreed that the dry cargo freight market was at least steady in most areas for most types of tonnage from Handy-size bulkers upwards, but there is a growing number who believed that it may be poised to move ahead again this week.

Owners were naturally hoping that the transition over the forthcoming holiday season will not see an interruption to the current trend and some owners' brokers reported an encouraging volume of enquiry for January loading.
The BFI rose 5 points on Tuesday to 1470.

GRAIN - Fixtures on voyage basis are conspicuous by their absence. Although charterers such as Continental have a number of early enquiries from the US Gulf and River Plate, nothing has been reported fixed. In fact, the activity which has been seen has generally been on a timecharter basis.

Pan Ocean, for example, booked Ioannis 77,300 dwt delivery Morocco mid Dec to cover grain from USGulf to Ghent at $11,500 daily, and UBC fixed the 1978-built Caravos Glory 60,797 dwt delivery prompt USGulf trip Japan at an economical $12,500 daily plus $250,000 bonus.

Romac fixed and failed on subjects with the NSAC-relet Alfios 63,408 dwt delivery prompt USGulf trip via Aqaba redelivery Aden at a hefty $15,000 daily plus $350,000 bonus. Another NSAC vessel, National Prestige 75,100 dwt, was rumoured fixed on subjects delivery prompt Immingham for 3-5 months at $12,750 daily.
In the east the Australian Wheat Board conceded a firm $7,500 daily for the 20-year old Toscana 63,159 dwt delivery prompt Singapore for a trip via Australia with grain to Egypt, redelivery Passero.

Hanjin were also engaged in this trade with Captain George 1 63,986 dwt delivery prompt N.China, redelivery Egyptian Med at $8,000 daily. The 1977-built Suerte 55,740 dwt was understood fixed on subjects Nopac/S.Korea, possibly by HMM.

Little fresh grain business was quoted today but Garnac have 10,250 tonnes corn pellets, 10,450 soyabean meal USGulf/Puerto Cabello for for Dec 18/25. Glencore now quote 14,000 soyabean meal pellets UpRiver/Iran for Dec 17/22 and brokers believed the lack of early tonnage in the area of Argentina will create problems fixing this business as well as Continental's 25,000 wheat Up River to Algeria also scheduled for prompt shipment.

MINERALS - Brokers spoke of steadier conditions spreading from the east into the Atlantic for Capers. Cobelfret were understood to hav fixed 120,000 coal Richards Bay/Rotterdam for Dec 15/30 and Preag the same for Jan 15/30, but full details were not available.

Brokers reported stronger demand for tonnage for ore and coal generally from S.Africa. Skaarup were linked with Kristjan Palusalu 52,650 dwt for 2 Atlantic rounds and Margem with a Panamax coal fixture from Mobile to Eregli, but details were kept private.

HANDY-SIZES - Pacific Carriers were said to have fixed and failed on subjects with Balaji Diplomat 3,505 dwt delivery prompt Continent trip far East at close to $11,900 daily, and Moller were rumoured to have fixed Prabhu Parvati 41,427 dwt for similar business at about the same level.

There was some activity in the east where brokers reported marginally firmer rates for craned tonnage. NYK were linked with Serafin Topic 37,000 dwt delivery Brisbane end Dec for a trip with silica sand to the far east at about $7,500 daily plus bonus (vessel will be ballasting from Taiwan).

Hugo Neu were said to have fixed 30,000 scrap for dec shipment California/S.Korea at $20.50. Pisces pioneer 35,310 dwt was rumoured fixed on subjects by S.Korean charterers delivery Semarang for a trip via W.Australia to China, and a sister vessel for a Nopac round, both at the equivalent of between $6,500 and $7,000 daily.
